qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (runtime records for reward discrimination required before local clearance; missing evidence remains a gap)
evidence: STRUCTURE (supports gradation): tests/scoring.toml lines 1-11: gates render=0.0/constraints=0.0, weights functional 0.6/polish 0.2/visual 0.2, floor functional=0.05; score.py line 46-48 computes a weighted continuous reward once gates and floor pass. Functional judge.toml: 44 independent binary criteria, aggregation weighted_mean, total weight 59.5, max single criterion 2.5 (4.2% of functional; hro_stale_refused, hro_live_board, hro_candidate_private), min 0.5 (0.8%). Polish: 5 binary criteria, weights 3/3/2/1.5/2.5 (total 12). Visual: 5 likert points=5 criteria with described anchors, weight 1.2 each. Functional prompt.md 'Global browser gate and independent scoring': 'score EACH criterion independently, continue after failures and keep successful observations. A failed sibling verdict is not evidence against another row ... When a setup step fails, set up the same thing again on a new job' and 'Never deduct one observed defect in more than one row' - these explicitly prevent a single precondition cascade. Polish/visual prompts carry the same independent-judging instruction. The only all-or-nothing preconditions are the two gates (render: wrong password refused + sign-in shows workspace; constraints: job+candidate created by Recruiter and seen by Observer in an independent context) and the 0.05 functional floor (>~3 of 59.5 weight points) - these exclude shells, and are cheap for any genuine attempt, so they do not collapse signal among partial apps. Worked partial-app spread (by weight arithmetic, not a run): a board-only app with correct stage/order/permission rules but no conversations loses roughly hro_msg_exchange, msg_compose, thread_latest, thread_earlier, unread_counts, unread_scrolled_up, seen, thread_access, drafts, candidate_linked (~17.5/59.5) plus live_board (2.5) -> functional ~0.66 if the rest pass; polish would keep failed_send/session_resume only if conversations exist, so polish could be 0-0.2; visual still graded 1-5. A full-feature app missing only live push would lose live_board, msg_exchange, unread_counts, unread_scrolled_up, seen (~9.5) and polish live rows (6/12). Distinct apps land at distinct points, so the design is graded, not binary. CONCERNS (compress but do not collapse spread): (a) Rows are highly conjunctive ('Fails if any condition stated above does not hold'; e.g. hro_activity requires a line for every action across S-V; hro_restart requires everything unchanged), so a mostly-right app may sit low; this is strictness, not binarity. (b) Several role rows (hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous) require replays of observed multi-card move and undo requests; an app lacking those publicly required features (instruction.md: 'I often move several candidates together ... undo my last move') also loses part of those rows - mitigated by the one-defect-one-row instruction. (c) Polish: 6 of 12 weight (hro_pol_live_board, hro_pol_live_thread) are 0 if no live update arrives in 15s, so live push dominates polish. (d) Functional prompt makes budget/tool exhaustion yield binary 0 'NOT EXERCISED'; protocols V, A, D run last, so on a 9000 s judge budget a long run could zero the same late rows for every app, compressing top-end spread equally - unmeasured. MEASUREMENT GAP (why not Pass): raw-evidence-index.json scope states verbatim 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent.' The only entries are a scripted golden driver run (workspace.cjs / results/workspace.json), explicitly 'Not a configured judge run, Oracle grade, model score'. No weak/mutated-app judge run shows an actual spread, which REVIEW_POLICY.md requires as a hash-bound reward-discrimination record. Per SKILL.md, an unmeasured claim is not upgraded to Pass. Counterexample search: plausible broken app that could pass - a static/seed-copy shell is stopped by the constraints gate (independent-context Observer readback of a newly created job and card); a browser-only save fails it. Conforming alternative that could be wrongly zeroed - a correct app whose judge run exhausts budget before V/A/D gets those rows 0 (harness, not discrimination defect; owned by workload rows). No design defect found in this row.
